gdp.note: Japanese fiscal year 2023. USD uses the calendar-year average exchange rate.

gdpPerCapita.note: Japanese fiscal year 2023. USD uses the calendar-year average exchange rate. Calculated as gross prefectural product divided by the same-year population in the Cabinet Office accounts (total population table); not prefectural income per person.
